-- BMgr.java --
package com.x;
import javax.baja.sys.BComponent;
import javax.baja.ui.BButton;
import javax.baja.ui.pane.BGridPane;
import javax.baja.workbench.view.BWbView;
import com.x.BExport;
public class BMgr extends BWbView {
  void build(BComponent parent) {
    BGridPane buttons = new BGridPane(4);
    buttons.add(null, new BButton(new AddCmd()));
    buttons.add(null, new BButton(new RemoveCmd()));
    add(null, buttons);
    BWbView v = new BWbView();
    add("v", v);
    parent.add("e", new BExport());
  }
}
-- BWild.java --
package com.x;
import javax.baja.ui.*;
public class BWild extends BWidget {
  void build() {
    add(null, new BButton());
  }
}
